article.story: NEW YORK -- — Josh Dalton scored 21 points as Elon opened the season Monday with an 84-71 victory over Columbia. Dalton added eight rebounds for the Phoenix. Hunter Harding scored 15 points while going 7 for 11 from the field, and added eight rebounds and eight assists. Bryson Cokley had 13 points and went 5 for 9 from the field. Josh Pratt led the Lions with 14 points and three steals. Columbia also got 14 points from Gerard O’Keefe. Josiah Cunningham added 13 points. Up next Elon hosts UNC Greensboro on Friday, and Columbia hosts SUNY-Old Westbury on Thursday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
